task: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! First thing I need you to do is to head west. With that done, assure that the hatch is wide open. And then, make an attempt to go to the south. With that over with, open the gateway inside the restroom. If you have opened the gateway, make an effort to go to the east. And then, venture south. After that, go east. And then, assure that the door within the dish-pit is ajar. Then, make an effort to venture south. Then, lift the passkey from the floor of the sauna. Alright, thanks!
description:
You're now in the cellar.

You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a cabinet. Make a note of this, you might have to put stuff on or in it later on. Empty! What kind of nightmare TextWorld is this? You make out a workbench. You wonder idly who left that here. The workbench is usual. However, the workbench, like an empty workbench, has nothing on it. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it?

There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unguarded.
